body:
One shared play-with-toy move, settings per pet:
- Monkey: throws the frisbee, runs, catches it, claps.
- Seal: bounces the ball on its nose, flipper clap.
- Bear: sits, squeezes the squeaky toy, squeak, rolls back.
- Snake: noses the toy mouse, coils round it.
Raises happiness like other toys. Friends see it too.
Toy models: frisbee and toy mouse are made; they wait for your pick (Objects chat).
Plan only today: the GIF comes after your OK.
